units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Jeremiah 14:18">Targ. Jer. XIV, 18</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Malachi 2:7">Targ. Mal. II, 7</cite>.
<cite ref="Onkelos Leviticus 1:7">Targ. Lev. I, 7</cite>; a. v. fr.—
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 110a:2">Snh. 110ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>כ׳ רבא</he> high priest.
<cite ref="Chullin 49a:19">Ḥull. 49ᵃ</cite> <he>ישמעאל כ׳ מסייע כהני</he> Ishmael, being a priest, favors the priests.

<cite ref="Gittin 59b:15">Gitt. 59ᵇ</cite> <he>קרי בכ׳</he> read from the Torah in the priest’s place, i.e. was called up the first; <cite ref="Megillah 22a">Meg. 22ᵃ</cite> Ms. O. (ed. <he>בכהני</he> pl.); a. fr.—Pl. <he>כַּהֲנִין</he>, <he>כַּהֲנַיָּא</he>, <cite ref="K00168"><he>כַּהֲנֵי</he></cite>.
Targ. O. Lev. I, 5; a. fr.—Gitt. l. c. כ׳ חשיבי דא״י highly esteemed Palestinean priests; a. fr.—Fem. (כֹּהֶנֶת) כַּהַנְתָּא.
<cite ref="Chullin 131b:21">Ḥull. 131ᵇ</cite> … <he>יהיב לכ׳</he> gave priestly gifts to a priest’s daughter (married to an Israelite).
<cite ref="Pesachim 49a:15">Pes. 49ᵃ</cite> <he>נסיב כ׳</he> married a priest’s daughter.—Pl. <cite ref="K00171"><he>כַּהֲנָתָא</he></cite>.
